title: Contrastive Audio-Visual Masked Autoencoder

layout.note: An irregular two-column grid: A) tokenization at the top left, a tall grey B) panel at the right stacking two framed component designs, and C) at the bottom left. A big grey Combination arrow points from B) to C).

lesson: To show a method that fuses two known objectives, draw both components in one grey panel in the same visual grammar as the final model and join them to it with a big labelled arrow. Use one colour per modality across tokens, encoders, embeddings and arrows so each stream can be followed through shared blocks.
